entries.question: Neurology medicine appointment kaise le
entries.answer:
KGMU mein Neurology department mein OPD appointment lene ke liye online registration karna anivarya (mandatory) hai. Aap in tareeqon se appointment le sakte hain:

1. **Online Booking (ORS Portal):** 
   - [ORS Portal](https://ors.gov.in) par jayein.
   - Apna state (Uttar Pradesh) aur hospital (KGMU) select karein.
   - New Appointment par click karke Neurology department aur available date/time select karein.
   - Patient details bharein aur ₹50 ka OPD slip fee pay karke slip download kar lein.

2. **Mobile App:** 
   - ABHA / Health Care App par mobile number aur OTP ke sath register karke same state aur hospital selection flow follow karein.

3. **SMS ke dwara:**
   - `Appointment [Patient Name]` likhkar `8887019134` par SMS bhejein.

4. **Walk-in (Hospital aakar):**
   - Apna Aadhaar number aur active mobile number ke sath counter par jayein, OTP verification ke baad ₹50 fee dekar physical token aur OPD slip collect karein (Parchi counter dopahar 1:00 baje sharp band ho jata hai).

**Zaroori Baatein:**
- OPD Timings: Somwar se Shukrawar (Mon–Fri) Subah 9:00 AM se dopahar 1:00 PM tak aur Shanivar (Sat) Subah 9:00 AM se 12:00 PM tak (Ravivar ko band).
- Agar aap Lucknow se bahar ke hain, toh apne sath kisi vishesh department ka valid referral letter zaroor layein. 
- Wait time se bachne ke liye pre-booking ki salah di jati hai.

*(Note: Main medical advice nahi de sakta. Kisi bhi samasya ke liye kripya KGMU OPD ke doctor se sampark karein.)*

entries.question: Mujhe digilocker ke through apni marksheet download krni hai batch 2020
entries.answer:
To download your marksheet or degree through DigiLocker for King George's Medical University (KGMU), you can follow these steps:

1. **Open DigiLocker:** Log in to your account on the [DigiLocker Website](https://www.digilocker.gov.in/) or open the DigiLocker mobile app.
2. **Search for Institution:** Go to the "Search Documents" section and look for **King George's Medical University (KGMU)** or Uttar Pradesh educational boards/universities depending on how the documents are hosted.
3. **Select Document Type:** Choose "Mark Sheet" or "Degree".
4. **Enter Details:** Input your registration/roll number, passing year (such as 2020 or your batch details), and other required credentials.
5. **Fetch Document:** Click on "Get Document". Once verified, the digital copy will be fetched and saved in your DigiLocker issued documents section.

For official verification, examination results, or degree-related queries, you can check the [KGMU Examination Results Portal](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_result/examination_result.php).

2. **Alternative Booking Methods:**
   - **ABHA/Health Care App:** Register using your mobile number and OTP, then follow the same hospital selection flow.
   - **SMS:** Send `Appointment [Patient Name]` to **8887019134**.
   - **Walk-in:** Visit the registration counter with your Aadhaar number and active mobile number to collect a physical token.
3. **Fees & Timings:** The OPD slip fee is ₹50. OPD timings are Monday to Friday (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) and Saturday (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM). Pre-booking is strongly recommended, and ticket counters close at 1:00 PM sharp.

*Note: If you are experiencing severe dental pain or a dental emergency outside OPD hours, please visit the KGMU Dental Emergency / Trauma Centre.*

entries.question: "माननीय सर/मैडम, मैं Dental Hygienist Diploma में एडमिशन लेना चाहता हूँ। कृपया बताने की कृपा करें: क्या 2026–27 में अभी एडमिशन खुले हैं या नहीं, और एडमिशन की प्रक्रिया क्या है?"
entries.answer:
वर्तमान में, वर्ष 2026-27 के लिए अलाइड एंड हेल्थकेयर साइंसेज (पैरामेडिकल) डिप्लोमा प्रवेश के संबंध में जो नवीनतम सूचना उपलब्ध है, उसके अनुसार:

1. **वर्तमान स्थिति:** KGMU की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना (संदर्भ: 1166/KGMUIPMS/2026, दिनांक 25-09-2026) के माध्यम से डिप्लोमा पाठ्यक्रमों के लिए प्रवेश प्रक्रिया से संबंधित निर्देश जारी किए गए हैं।
2. **प्रवेश प्रक्रिया:** आप विस्तृत जानकारी, पात्रता और काउंसलिंग प्रक्रिया के लिए सीधे आधिकारिक वेबसाइट [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) पर 'Admissions' अनुभाग देखें। 
3. **महत्वपूर्ण लिंक:** प्रवेश संबंधी नवीनतम अपडेट के लिए आप यहाँ क्लिक कर सकते हैं:
   - [KGMU Admissions Page](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php)
   - [Allied and Healthcare Sciences (Paramedical) Diploma Admission Notice 2026-27](https://www.kgmu.org/upload_file/user_download/6ed6eac547c417de5e71039988992dc7.pdf)

आपको सलाह दी जाती है कि आप नियमित रूप से [KGMU नोटिस बोर्ड](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php) चेक करते रहें, क्योंकि सभी महत्वपूर्ण तिथियां और काउंसलिंग कार्यक्रम वहीं अपडेट किए जाते हैं।

entries.question: Mujhe appointment chahie thi kaise milegi kya vahan jakar offline kam ho sakta hai ya online hi book karni padegi
entries.answer:

entries.question: How to book appointment
entries.answer:
To book an OPD appointment at King George's Medical University (KGMU), online registration is mandatory. You can use any of the following methods:

1. **Online Registration System (ORS):**
   - Visit [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in).
   - Log in or register using your mobile number, select **Uttar Pradesh**, choose **KGMU**, select the department and date, enter patient details, pay the ₹50 OPD slip fee, and download your appointment slip.

2. **ABHA / Health Care App:**
   - Register using your mobile number and OTP, then follow the same state and hospital selection flow as above.

3. **SMS Booking:**
   - Send an SMS in the format `Appointment [Patient Name]` to **8887019134**.

4. **Walk-in Booking:**
   - Visit the hospital with your Aadhaar number and active mobile number to complete OTP verification, obtain a physical token, pay the ₹50 fee, and collect your OPD slip at the counter.

**Important Notes:**
- The OPD slip fee is ₹50 for all booking methods.
- OPD timings are Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM, and Saturday from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM (closed on Sundays). 
- The ticket counter closes at 1:00 PM sharp.
- Outside-city patients must bring a valid referral for the specific department. Pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times.

entries.answer:
If you have completed your D. Pharm (Diploma in Pharmacy) and are looking for a job at King George's Medical University (KGMU) or in general, here is the process and guidance:

1. **Check for Official Vacancies:** 
   KGMU regularly releases recruitment notices, contractual positions, and project-based openings for pharmacists on the official website. You can check the current notices on the [KGMU Notice Board](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php).

2. **Registration:**
   Ensure you are registered as a qualified pharmacist with the State Pharmacy Council (such as the Uttar Pradesh Pharmacy Council), as valid registration is mandatory for any pharmacy job.

3. **Application Process:**
   When a pharmacist recruitment notice is published, you will need to apply through the specified online portal or submit the required application form along with your educational documents, pharmacy council registration certificate, and ID proof.

4. **External Opportunities:**
   Apart from university hospitals, your D. Pharm qualification makes you eligible for positions in government hospitals, retail pharmacies, pharmaceutical companies, and private hospital dispensaries.

For more details on ongoing admissions, guidelines, and recruitment processes, please visit the [KGMU Official Website](https://www.kgmu.org).
